verdict.rationale: Vestd says you can authorise a share pool and "instantly distribute the equity to one or more recipients," which suggests multi-recipient issuance in one action. Its migration offering ("Digitise or move your existing scheme") implies historical cap-table data can be brought in. However, nothing describes a self-serve bulk upload of grants or historical transactions. Missing for 10: documented CSV/spreadsheet bulk import of grants or historical transactions, details of batch option-grant workflows, and independent or hands-on confirmation that migration is self-serve rather than assisted.
